alignments.note: Prohibitive אַל takes the written *not*; the unit is discontinuous from the verb it negates under rule 25.
Hithpael; the reflexive *thyself* realizes the verb's own voice and stays with it under rule 44 rather than being an unlicensed supplied object.

בְּ on the construct noun יוֹם is rendered by the single word *of*; rule 30's one-rendering condition is met, so the pair fuses, headed on the construct noun (rule 23). The ASV writes no word for *day* here.
Rectum of the fused phrase keeps its own word.
כִּי takes the connective the ASV wrote for it.
Discontinuous from the verb under rule 25.
Subject pronoun realizing the verb's person and number joins it under rule 17; head on the lexical verb.
Modal auxiliary and the phrasal *forth* belong to the verb; *forth* completes a lexeme *bring* alone does not write (rule 44).
Indefinite *a* belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 15).

review_notes: The second יוֹם (s011) is a separate absolute occurrence, not a repetition of the fused בְּיוֹם, so rule 22 does not reach it.

Competing reading for s003/s004: splitting *of* onto בְּ and marking יוֹם unrepresented; rejected because rule 30 forbids leaving one morpheme of a preposition-plus-construct pair unrepresented beside the other holding the whole word.
